name: Turn-of-month
tagline: Holds TQQQ in the last five and first six sessions of each month.
summary: A pure calendar tilt around the month boundary, with no trend or price signal and BIL outside the window. Dev CAGR is 41.41% but full is 33.62%, below TQQQ's 37.54%, and the holdout earns only 16.00%; the 11-session window is wide and the edge is not a clean turn-of-month effect.
caveat: The full 2016-2026 CAGR is 33.62% versus TQQQ's 37.54% and the holdout earns only 16.00%; the dev pass is concentrated in 2020/2023 and depends on excluding one mid-month session, so the calendar edge is fragile rather than robust.
